path.description: File path relative to codebase root (e.g. 'src/main.rs' or 'Cargo.toml')

start_line.description: 1-indexed line to start reading from (default: 1). Use the value the previous result's continuation marker names to page through a file larger than max_lines.

max_lines.description: Maximum number of lines to return (default: 500)

prepend_context.description: Optional text to prepend to the output before the file content — useful in chains where {{_prev}} carries prior step output that should be passed forward alongside the file.
